authority.purpose: Prevent P0/P1 audit findings from being bypassed through premature Done, PASS, review-ready, cutover, rollback or retirement claims.

invariants: Repository implementation alone cannot satisfy a live or merchant acceptance gate.
A downstream package cannot close while any mandatory upstream containment gate is open.
Unknown, unavailable, unsupported, stale, partial and error states cannot be represented as measured zero.
Uninstall, data deletion and clean reinstall are separate lifecycle states and cannot substitute for one another.
Audit finding closure requires exact acceptance evidence and an explicit status transition.

gates.name: shopify_review_ready
additional_required_acceptance: R8 acceptance or an explicit versioned decision removing it from the review critical path
gates.release_rule: All applicable package evidence is reviewed; Security Regression passes; required merchant/live acceptance is explicit.

gates.name: delete_my_data_complete
gates.release_rule: Versioned manifest, durable claim, resumable execution, zero-residue checks, redacted evidence and completion UI are verified end to end.

gates.name: clean_reinstall_safe
gates.release_rule: Pre-redact reinstall and post-terminal-deletion reinstall are separately tested; terminal path creates an isolated new workspace/install generation.

gates.name: truthful_funnel_cutover
gates.release_rule: Fact provenance/finality and formula support reach API/UI; absence/error/unknown never renders measured zero.

gates.name: rollback_truth_safe
gates.release_rule: Failure injection proves rollback preserves loading, empty, error, stale, support and finality truth.

gates.name: legacy_retirement
gates.release_rule: Cutover stabilization, consumer-zero observation, restore point and separate destructive approval are all present.

status_transition.authority: Explicit evidence-backed Execution Plan/contract update reviewed through PR.
forbidden: Automatic transition from passing unit tests

rollback: Reverting this document does not authorize bypassing an open audit finding; any superseding policy must explicitly map every gate and source finding.
